title: A mechanical check for diagrams
tagline: Broken pictures named in a second
intro: This is a small checker for the picture files that the two diagram skills produce.

steps.say: It names every broken link, repeated name and missing size it finds in the picture.
When the picture is clean, it says so and reports the smallest text size at the width the picture will have on a page.

outro: Mistakes that used to be found later by someone squinting at a rendered page are now caught in a second, before the diagram is handed over.
